scripts.dev: npm run build -w @navalha/contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @navalha/contracts" "npm run dev -w @navalha/api" "npm run dev -w @navalha/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @navalha/contracts && npm run build -w @navalha/api && npm run build -w @navalha/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @navalha/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @navalha/api && npm run typecheck -w @navalha/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
